name: player_clear_pending_contact_queues
description: Player::ClearPendingContactQueues frees the pending contact chains owned by a player state and resets all six queue headers.
known_limits: The smoke covers the queue-free/reset contract for populated and empty queues. tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player pending-contact source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x423530 validates the six queue offsets, next pointer at node offset 0x44, delete loop, and four-dword zero reset per queue.
The native smoke verifies every queue header is cleared after representative pending contact chains are released.
